init_roberta_connector: initialize a Roberta connector from a pretrained fairseq RoBERTa model directory and checkpoint
get_token_ids: get the token IDs for an input string using the RoBERTa BPE encoder and source dictionary
get_batch_generation: run batched masked language model generation on sentences with [MASK] tokens and return log probabilities
build_roberta_vocab: build a full RoBERTa vocabulary list by decoding all BPE tokens and handling subword prefixes
use_roberta_vocab_lookup: use RobertaVocab to decode a token ID back to its original string via BPE decoding
